articles.title: At least 15 attackers exploited Coldcard vulnerability: Galaxy
articles.snippet: Galaxy said that at least 15 different attackers have exploited the Coldcard vulnerability, which may have been avoided with just $2 worth of AI hardening, according to Dragonfly’s managing partner.

articles.title: Jim Cramer plans to sell his Bitcoin over quantum fears as BTC rises 1.6%
articles.snippet: The CNBC personality said he’ll sell his Bitcoin holdings due to fears about quantum computing, as some cryptocurrency investors celebrated, referencing the popular “inverse Cramer” meme.

articles.title: Google Yanks Google Earth AI Image Tool a Day After Launch Over Deepfake Fears
articles.snippet: The Nano Banana tool let users generate fake satellite scenes from a text prompt, alarming investigators who rely on Google Earth to verify breaking news and atrocities.

articles.title: $38M in Bitcoin Drained by Coldcard Key Flaw Its Maker Thinks AI Found
articles.snippet: Coinkite said it’s likely that an attacker used AI to review previous versions of its open source firmware to uncover a vulnerability.
